_help.about: How branches, bamboo and vines behave when you catch and swing on them (design reconciliation: the limit is in the handhold, not the player). A plant entry in data/plants or data/biomes can carry its own "handhold" block with any of these keys; otherwise its genus row here, else bamboo or vine, else default. Restart the game after editing.
_help.break_speed_mps: Catch or swing faster than this and it snaps: you fly on with movement.swing.snap_speed_keep of your speed, and it's gone. Scaled by the wood's thickness against ref_radius_m (thinner breaks sooner), not for vines and bamboo.
_help.flex: How much it bends under you when you catch it (0 rigid .. 1 very whippy).
_help.snapback: How much of that bend comes back as a push when you let go on the rebound (0 a plain pendulum .. 1 a launch).
_help.hold_load: The load it bears hanging still: you weigh 1 plus 0.15 per carried thing. Under it you can hang forever; over it, it gives way after a moment. Scaled by thickness like break_speed_mps.
_help.dead: Dead wood (snags, dry bamboo): break_scale and hold_scale multiply the living values; flex and snapback replace them. It cracks.
_help.sapling: Trees shorter than sapling_height_m: break_scale multiplies the break speed, flex_add adds to flex (whippy, fragile).
